verify its scope against the complete source pages.","signals":["shall","shall"],"text":"(a) When the President, or the Secretary of State or the Secretary \nof the Treasury pursuant to authority delegated by the President and in \naccordance with the terms of such delegation, has determined that sanctions \nshall be imposed on a person pursuant to sections 224(a)(2), 231(a), 232(a), \nor 233(a) of CAATSA and has selected from section 235 of CAATSA any \nof the sanctions set forth below to impose on that person, the Secretary \nof the Treasury, in consultation with the Secretary of State, shall take the \nfollowing actions where necessary to implement the sanctions selected and \nmaintained by the President, the Secretary of State, or the Secretary of \nthe Treasury: \n(i) prohibit any United States financial institution from making loans \nor providing credits to the sanctioned person totaling more than \n$10,000,000 in any 12-month period, unless the person is engaged in \nactivities to relieve human suffering and the loans or credits are provided \nfor such activities; \n(ii) prohibit any transactions in foreign exchange that are subject to the \njurisdiction of the United States and in which the sanctioned person \nhas any interest; \n(iii) prohibit any transfers of credit or payments between financial institu-\ntions, or by, through, or to any financial institution, to the extent that \nsuch transfers or payments are subject to the jurisdiction of the United \nStates and involve any interest of the sanctioned person; \n(iv) block all property and interests in property of the sanctioned person \nthat are in the United States, that hereafter come within the United States, \nor that are or hereafter come within the possession or control of any \nUnited States person, and provide that such property and interests in \nproperty may not be transferred, paid, exported, withdrawn, or otherwise \ndealt in; \n(v) prohibit any United States person from investing in or purchasing \nsignificant amounts of equity or debt instruments of the sanctioned person; \nor \nVerDate Sep<11>2014 19:27 Sep 20, 2018 Jkt 244001 PO 00000 Frm 00003 Fmt 4705 Sfmt 4790 E:\\FR\\FM\\21SEE0.SGM 21SEE0daltland on DSKBBV9HB2PROD with PRES DOCS\n=== PDF page 2 of 6 ===\n48196 Federal Register / Vol. 83, No. 184 / Friday, September 21, 2018 / Presidential Documents \n(vi) impose on the principal executive officer or officers of the sanctioned \nperson, or on persons performing similar functions and with similar au-\nthorities as such officer or officers, the sanctions described in subsections \n(a)(i)–(a)(v) of this section, as selected by the President, the Secretary \nof State, or the Secretary of the Treasury."},{"char_end":8616,"char_start":5099,"classification":"clause_candidate","context_char_end":8616,"context_char_start":5099,"line":82,"pdf_page":2,"reason":"Command-like sentence has substantive text outside submitted inventory; verify its scope against the complete source pages.","signals":["shall","shall","shall","shall","shall","shall","shall","shall","shall","shall","shall"],"text":"(a) When the President, or the Secretary of State or the Secretary \nof the Treasury pursuant to authority delegated by the President and in \naccordance with the terms of such delegation, has determined that sanctions \nshall be imposed on a person pursuant to sections 224(a)(2), 231(a), 232(a), \nor 233(a) of CAATSA and has selected from section 235 of CAATSA any \nof the sanctions set forth below to impose on that person, the heads of \nrelevant departments and agencies, in consultation with the Secretary of \nState and the Secretary of the Treasury, as appropriate, shall ensure that \nthe following actions are taken where necessary to implement the sanctions \nselected and maintained by the President, the Secretary of State, or the \nSecretary of the Treasury: \n(i) The Export-Import Bank shall deny approval of the issuance of any \nguarantee, insurance, extension of credit, or participation in an extension \nof credit in connection with the export of any goods or services to the \nsanctioned person; \n(ii) Departments and agencies shall not issue any specific license or grant \nany other specific permission or authority under any statute that requires \nthe prior review or approval of the United States Government as a condition \nfor the export or reexport of goods or technology to the sanctioned person; \n(iii) The United States executive director of each international financial \ninstitution shall use the voice and vote of the United States to oppose \nany loan from the international financial institution that would benefit \nthe sanctioned person; \n(iv) With respect to a sanctioned person that is a financial institution: \nthe Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and the Federal \nReserve Bank of New York shall not designate, or permit the continuation \nof any prior designation of, the sanctioned person as a primary dealer \nin United States Government debt instruments; and departments and agen-\ncies shall prevent the sanctioned person from serving as an agent of \nthe United States Government or serving as a repository for United States \nGovernment funds; \n(v) Departments and agencies shall not procure, or enter into a contract \nfor the procurement of, any goods or services from the sanctioned person; \n(vi) The Secretary of State shall deny a visa to, and the Secretary of \nHomeland Security shall exclude from the United States, any alien that \nthe President, the Secretary of State, or the Secretary of the Treasury \ndetermines is a corporate officer or principal of, or a shareholder with \na controlling interest in, the sanctioned person by treating the person \nas covered by section 1 of Proclamation 8693 of July 24, 2011 (Suspension \nof Entry of Aliens Subject to United Nations Security Council Travel \nBans and International Emergency Economic Powers Act Sanctions); or \n(vii) The heads of the relevant departments and agencies, as appropriate, \nshall impose on the principal executive officer or officers of the sanctioned \nVerDate Sep<11>2014 19:27 Sep 20, 2018 Jkt 244001 PO 00000 Frm 00004 Fmt 4705 Sfmt 4790 E:\\FR\\FM\\21SEE0.SGM 21SEE0daltland on DSKBBV9HB2PROD with PRES DOCS\n=== PDF page 3 of 6 ===\n48197 Federal Register / Vol. 83, No. 184 / Friday, September 21, 2018 / Presidential Documents \nperson, or on persons performing similar functions and with similar au-\nthorities as such officer or officers, the sanctions described in subsections \n(a)(i)–(a)(vi) of this section, as selected by the President, the Secretary \nof State, or the Secretary of the Treasury."},{"char_end":10835,"char_start":8922,"classification":"clause_candidate","context_char_end":10835,"context_char_start":8922,"line":136,"pdf_page":3,"reason":"Command-like sentence has substantive text outside submitted inventory; - **ACT:EO:10789>EO:12919**; S538c51350de60909faece2f4; {"actor_id":"EO:12919","char_end":36359,"char_start":36139,"confidence":"medium","effective_class":"unknown","effective_date":null,"effective_wording":[{"char_end":4626,"char_start":3802,"text":"=== PDF page 186 of 204 ===\n29526 Federal Register / Vol. 59, No. 108 / Tuesday, June 7, 1994 / Presidential Documents\n(2.) Provide for the central coordination of the plans and programs *  \nincident to authorities and functions delegated under this order,  \nand provide guidance and procedures approved by the Assistant  \nto the President for National Security Affairs to the Federal depart­\nments and agencies under this order;\n(3) Establish procedures» in consultation with Federal departments  \nand agencies assigned functions under this order, to résolve in  \na. timely and effective manner conflicts and issues that may arise  \nin implementing the authorities and functions delegated under this  \norder; and\n(4) Report to the President periodically concerning all program activi­\nties conducted pursuant to this order."},{"char_end":19388,"char_start":19207,"text":"The heads of  \nFederal departments and agencies shall provide the Secretary of Commerce  \nwith such information as may be necessary for the effective performance  \nof this function."},{"char_end":23013,"char_start":22634,"text":"(g) This order suspends any delegated authority, regulation, or other re­\nquirement or condition with respect to the activation of any NDER unit, \nin whole or in part, or appointment of any NDER member that is inconsistent \nwith the authorities delegated herein, provided that the aforesaid suspension \napplies only as long as sections 703(a) an(K710(e) of the Act are in effect."},{"char_end":25404,"char_start":24067,"text":"=== PDF page 191 of 204 ===\nFederal Register / Vol. 59, No. 108 / Tuesday, June 7, 1994 / Presidential Documents 29531\nactions on labor supply and utilization, (2) the relation of labor supply  \nto materials and facilities requirements, and (3) such other matters as will  \nassist in making the exercise of priority and allocations functions consistent  \nwith effective utilization and distribution of labor;\n(c) Formulate plans, programs, and policies for meeting defense and essen­\ntial civilian labor requirements;\n(d) Project skill shortages to facilitate meeting defense and essential civilian \nneeds and establish training programs;\n(e) Determine the occupations and skills critical to meeting the labor  \nrequirements of defense and essential civilian activities and, with the assist­\nance of the Secretary of Defense, the Director of Selective Service, and  \nsuch other persons as the Director, FEMA, may designate, develop policies  \nregulating the induction and deferment of personnel for the armed services,  \nexcept for civilian personnel in the reserves; and\n(f) Administer an effective labor-management relations policy to support \nthe activities and programs under this order with the cooperation of other \nFederal agencies, including the National Labor Relations Board and the \nFederal Mediation and Conciliation Service."},{"char_end":27548,"char_start":27285,"text":"(d) The Secretary of Defense shall report to Congress on a strategic plan  \nfor developing a cost-effective, comprehensive information system capable  \nof identifying on a timely, ongoing basis vulnerability in critical components  \nand critical technology items."},{"char_end":34922,"char_start":34625,"text":"A u thority,  All previously issued orders, regulations, rulings, certifi­\ncates, directives, and other actions relating to any function affected by this  \norder shall remain in effect except as they are inconsistent with this order  \nor are subsequently amended or revoked under proper authority."}],"exceptions_text":[],"filing_date":null,"id":"ACT:EO:10789>EO:12919","names_target":true,"notes":"Machine lead only; no legal ending or revival asserted. - **ACT:EO:10789>EO:13286**; Sd3145c7b44424f882132e4cb; {"actor_id":"EO:13286","char_end":40353,"char_start":40075,"confidence":"medium","effective_class":"unknown","effective_date":null,"effective_wording":[{"char_end":2501,"char_start":2411,"text":"Executive Order 13260 of March 19, 2002, is hereby revoked effective as of March 31, 2003."},{"char_end":41701,"char_start":40943,"text":"(a)\nin the case of the Department of Defense, the Secretary of Defense has, after consideration of the authority provided under subtitle G of title VIII of the Homeland Security Act of 2002, determined that the exercise of authority under this order is necessary for the timely and effective conduct of United States military or intelligence activities; and\n(b)\nin the case of any other executive department or agency that has authority under this order, (i) the Secretary of Homeland Security has advised whether the use of the authority provided under subtitle G of title VIII of the Homeland Security Act of 2002 would be appropriate, and (ii) the Director of the Office and Management and Budget has approved the exercise of authority under this order.\"."},{"char_end":49577,"char_start":49526,"text":"This order shall become effective on March 1, 2003."}],"exceptions_text":[],"filing_date":null,"id":"ACT:EO:10789>EO:13286","names_target":true,"notes":"Machine lead only; no legal ending or revival asserted. Effective wording is ambiguous, section-specific, or has no determinable date.","provision_label":"Sec. 73.","reaches_target_via":"","savings_phrases":["Without prejudice to subsections (a) through (i) of this section, all responsibilities assigned to specific Federal officials pursuant to Executive Order 12656 that are substantially the same as any responsibility assigned to, or function transferred to, the Secretary of Homeland Security pursuant to the Homeland Security Act of 2002 (regardless of whether such responsibility or function is expressly required to be carried out through another official of the Department of Homeland Security or not pursuant to such Act), or intended or required to be carried out by an agency or an agency component transferred to the Department of Homeland Security pursuant to such Act, are hereby reassigned to the Secretary of Homeland Security.","Executive Order 11239 of July 31, 1965 (\"Enforcement of the Convention for Safety of Life at Sea, 1960\"), as amended, is further amended, without prejudice to section 1–106 of Executive Order 12234 of September 3, 1980 (\"Enforcement of the Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea\"), by:","Savings Provision."],"scope":"partial","signing_date":"2003-02-28","target_id":"EO:10789","verb":"amend"}

from blocked funds."},{"char_end":20128,"char_start":19907,"text":"(a) Any transaction on or after the effective date that evades or avoids, has the purpose of evading or avoiding, causes a violation of, or attempts to violate any of the prohibitions set forth in this part is prohibited."},{"char_end":26495,"char_start":26124,"text":"Note 1 to § 547.302:\nSee § 547.411 concerning the blocked status of property and interests in property of an entity that is directly or indirectly owned, whether individually or in the aggregate, 50 percent or more by one or more persons whose property and interests in property are blocked pursuant to § 547.201(a).\n[83 FR 57312, Nov. 15, 2018]\n§ 547.303 Effective date."},{"char_end":27044,"char_start":26496,"text":"(a) The term effective date refers to the effective date of the applicable prohibitions and directives contained in this part as follows:\n(1) With respect to a person whose property and interests in property are blocked pursuant to § 547.201(a)(1), 12:01 a.m. eastern standard time on October 30, 2006; and\n(2) With respect to a person whose property and interests in property are otherwise blocked pursuant to § 547.201(a), the earlier of the date of actual or constructive notice that such person's property and interests in property are blocked."},{"char_end":41512,"char_start":41222,"text":"A setoff against blocked property (including a blocked account), whether by a U.S. bank or other U.S. person, is a prohibited transfer under § 547.201 if effected after the effective date.\n§ 547.411 Entities owned by one or more persons whose property and interests in property are blocked."}],"exceptions_text":["Except where intended for the authorized support of humanitarian activities or the authorized use by or support of peacekeeping, international, or government forces, to have directly or indirectly supplied, sold, or transferred to the Democratic Republic of the Congo, or been the recipient in the territory of the Democratic Republic of the Congo of, arms and related materiel, including military aircraft and equipment, or advice, training, or assistance, including financing and financial assistance, related to military activities"],"filing_date":null,"id":"ACT:EO:13413>EO:13671@2a2ae19313898ea9","names_target":true,"notes":"Machine lead only; no legal ending or revival asserted. Effective wording is ambiguous, section-specific, or has no determinable date.","provision_label":"","reaches_target_via":"","savings_phrases":["The terms property and property interest include, but are not limited to, money, checks, drafts, bullion, bank deposits, savings accounts, debts, indebtedness, obligations, notes, guarantees, debentures, stocks, bonds, coupons, any other financial instruments, bankers' acceptances, mortgages, pledges, liens or other rights in the nature of security, warehouse receipts, bills of lading, trust receipts, bills of sale, any other evidences of title, ownership or indebtedness, letters of credit and any documents relating to any rights or obligations thereunder, powers of attorney, goods, wares, merchandise, chattels, stocks on hand, ships, goods on ships, real estate mortgages, deeds of trust, vendors' sales agreements, land contracts, leaseholds, ground rents, real estate and any other interest therein, options, negotiable instruments, trade acceptances, royalties, book accounts, accounts payable, judgments, patents, trademarks or copyrights, insurance policies, safe deposit boxes and their contents, annuities, pooling agreements, services of any nature whatsoever, contracts of any nature whatsoever, and any other property, real, personal, or mixed, tangible or intangible, or interest or interests therein, present, future or contingent.\n§ 547.309 Transfer.","It includes depository institutions, banks, savings banks, trust companies, securities brokers and dealers, futures and options brokers and dealers, forward contract and foreign exchange merchants, securities and commodities exchanges, clearing corporations, investment companies, employee benefit plans, and U.S. holding companies, U.S. affiliates, or U.S. subsidiaries of any of the foregoing."],"scope":"partial","signing_date":"2014-07-08","target_id":"EO:13413","verb":"transfer"}

chronology does not decide legal effect.","provision_text":"Subsection (a) of section 1 of Executive Order 13413 is hereby\namended to read as follows:\n‘‘(a) All property and interests in property that are in the United States,\nthat hereafter come within the United States, or that are or hereafter come\nwithin the possession or control of any United States person (including\nany foreign branch) of the following persons are blocked and may not\nbe transferred, paid, exported, withdrawn, or otherwise dealt in:\n(i) the persons listed in the Annex to this order; and\n(ii) any person determined by the Secretary of the Treasury, in consultation\nwith the Secretary of State:\n(A) to be a political or military leader of a foreign armed group operating\nin the Democratic Republic of the Congo that impedes the disarmament,\ndemobilization, voluntary repatriation, resettlement, or reintegration of\ncombatants;\n(B) to be a political or military leader of a Congolese armed group\nthat impedes the disarmament, demobilization, voluntary repatriation, re-\nsettlement, or reintegration of combatants;\n(C) to be responsible for or complicit in, or to have engaged in, directly\nor indirectly, any of the following in or in relation to the Democratic\nRepublic of the Congo:\n(1) actions or policies that threaten the peace, security, or stability\nof the Democratic Republic of the Congo;\n(2) actions or policies that undermine democratic processes or institu-\ntions in the Democratic Republic of the Congo;\n(3) the targeting of women, children, or any civilians through the\ncommission of acts of violence (including killing, maiming, torture,\nor rape or other sexual violence), abduction, forced displacement, or\nattacks on schools, hospitals, religious sites, or locations where civil-\nians are seeking refuge, or through conduct that would constitute a\nserious abuse or violation of human rights or a violation of inter-\nnational humanitarian law;\n(4) the use or recruitment of children by armed groups or armed\nforces in the context of the conflict in the Democratic Republic of\nthe Congo;\n(5) the obstruction of the delivery or distribution of, or access to, hu-\nmanitarian assistance;\n(6) attacks against United Nations missions, international security\npresences, or other peacekeeping operations; or\n(7) support to persons, including armed groups, involved in activities\nthat threaten the peace, security, or stability of the Democratic Repub-\nlic of the Congo or that undermine democratic processes or institu-\ntions in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, through the illicit\ntrade in natural resources of the Democratic Republic of the Congo;\n(D) except where intended for the authorized support of humanitarian\nactivities or the authorized use by or support of peacekeeping, inter-\nnational, or government forces, to have directly or indirectly supplied,\nsold, or transferred to the Democratic Republic of the Congo, or been\nthe recipient in the territory of the Democratic Republic of the Congo\nof, arms and related materiel, including military aircraft and equipment,\nor advice, training, or assistance, including financing and financial assist-\nance, related to military activities;\n(E) to be a leader of (i) an entity, including any armed group, that\nhas, or whose members have, engaged in any of the activities described\nin subsections (a)(ii)(A) through (a)(ii)(D) of this section or (ii) an entity\nwhose property and interests in property are blocked pursuant to this\norder;\n(F) to have materially assisted, sponsored, or provided financial, material,\nlogistical, or technological support for, or goods or services in support\nof (i) any of the activities described in subsections (a)(ii)(A) through\n(a)(ii)(D) of this section or (ii) any person whose property and interests\nin property are blocked pursuant to this order; or\n(G) to be owned or controlled by, or to have acted or purported to\nact for or on behalf of, directly or indirectly, any person whose property\nand interests in property are blocked pursuant to this order.’’\nSec. 2 .","sections_touched":["section 1"],"signing_date":"2014-07-08","source":{"acceptable_as_original":false,"filing_date":null,"grade":"held_text_lead","instrument_id":"EO:13671","page_or_item":"79 FR 39949-39951 (PDF pp. 1-3)","requires_page_check":false,"sha256":"ac1fbe33a97865423170cebb64494fe5b56dd57143d05589f9a88b3aff191ad0","signing_date":"2014-07-08","text_path":"jobs/clause-drafts/output/texts/cd-stage21-13671-ac1fbe33a9.txt","text_sha256":"3be3bcca8489ae67ea36f9f7959430305790429b14361e04436dead4cb9b992f","url":"https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2014-07-10/pdf/2014-16360.pdf"},"verb":"amend"},{"actor_id":"EO:13671","char_end":6361,"char_start":2055,"confidence":"medium","how_named":"direct","id":"CHAIN:EO:13413#3","notes":"Change wording lead; - **ACT:EO:13111>EO:13218**; S23c61fe2029932805fcf5bbf; {"actor_id":"EO:13218","char_end":6827,"char_start":6540,"confidence":"medium","effective_class":"unknown","effective_date":null,"effective_wording":[{"char_end":8366,"char_start":6865,"text":"The Committee shall provide\nthe President, through the Secretary of Labor (who shall ensure the coordina-\ntion of the activities of the Committee with the activities undertaken pursuant\nto sections 1 and 2 of the Executive Order on the 21st Century Workforce\nInitiative), an independent assessment of:\n(1) progress made by the Federal Government in its use and integration\nof technology in adult training programs, particularly in addressing the\nproblems of adult illiteracy;\n(2) how Federal Government programs, initiatives, and policies can en-\ncourage or accelerate training technology to provide more accessible, more\ntimely, and more cost- effective training opportunities for all Americans;\n(3) mechanisms for the Federal Government to widely deploy and utilize\ntechnology-mediated instruction so all Americans may take advantage of\nopportunities provided by learning technology;\nVerDate 11<MAY>2000 15:47 Jun 21, 2001 Jkt 194001 PO 00000 Frm 00004 Fmt 4705 Sfmt 4790 E:\\FR\\FM\\22JNE0.SGM pfrm04 PsN: 22JNE0\n=== PDF page 3 of 3 ===\n33629Federal Register / Vol. 66, No. 121 / Friday, June 22, 2001 / Presidential Documents\n(4) the appropriate Federal Government role in research and development\nfor learning technologies and their applications in order to develop high-\nquality training and education opportunities for all Americans; and\n(5) such other issues regarding emerging technologies in government\ntraining as specified by the Secretary of Labor.’’\n(b) Revocation of Executive Order 13174."}],"exceptions_text":[],"filing_date":null,"id":"ACT:EO:13111>EO:13218","names_target":true,"notes":"Machine lead only; no legal ending or revival asserted. - **ACT:EO:13111>EO:13218@556ac2c890d3e93b**; Sdba59ea0823c4622e7edced8; {"actor_id":"EO:13218","char_end":6827,"char_start":6540,"confidence":"medium","effective_class":"unknown","effective_date":null,"effective_wording":[{"char_end":8366,"char_start":6865,"text":"The Committee shall provide\nthe President, through the Secretary of Labor (who shall ensure the coordina-\ntion of the activities of the Committee with the activities undertaken pursuant\nto sections 1 and 2 of the Executive Order on the 21st Century Workforce\nInitiative), an independent assessment of:\n(1) progress made by the Federal Government in its use and integration\nof technology in adult training programs, particularly in addressing the\nproblems of adult illiteracy;\n(2) how Federal Government programs, initiatives, and policies can en-\ncourage or accelerate training technology to provide more accessible, more\ntimely, and more cost- effective training opportunities for all Americans;\n(3) mechanisms for the Federal Government to widely deploy and utilize\ntechnology-mediated instruction so all Americans may take advantage of\nopportunities provided by learning technology;\nVerDate 11<MAY>2000 15:47 Jun 21, 2001 Jkt 194001 PO 00000 Frm 00004 Fmt 4705 Sfmt 4790 E:\\FR\\FM\\22JNE0.SGM pfrm04 PsN: 22JNE0\n=== PDF page 3 of 3 ===\n33629Federal Register / Vol. 66, No. 121 / Friday, June 22, 2001 / Presidential Documents\n(4) the appropriate Federal Government role in research and development\nfor learning technologies and their applications in order to develop high-\nquality training and education opportunities for all Americans; and\n(5) such other issues regarding emerging technologies in government\ntraining as specified by the Secretary of Labor.’’\n(b) Revocation of Executive Order 13174."}],"exceptions_text":[],"filing_date":null,"id":"ACT:EO:13111>EO:13218@556ac2c890d3e93b","names_target":true,"notes":"Machine lead only; no legal ending or revival asserted. ' (a) The President shall award the \nNational Medal of Science (hereinafter referred to as the Medal) \nestablished by the Act, the specifications of which are prescribed by \nExecutive Order No. 10910 of January 17, 1961, as amended, on the \nbasis of recommendations received by him in accordance with the pro­\nvisions of this Order to individuals who in his judgment are deserving \nof special recognition by reason of their outstanding contributions \nto knowledge in the physical, biological, mathematical, or engineering \nsciences."}]},{"affected_orders":["EO:12139"],"availability":"held_not_loaded","kind":"load_actor_overflow","reasons":["Read full overflow before scope/savings decision"],"shared_key":"EO:12333","task_id":"TASK:5a45ce5d9abd2907dea27d12"},{"affected_orders":["EO:12139"],"availability":"citation_or_pointer_only","kind":"operative_current_law","reasons":["No uniquely located attributed legal-text slice is held for this current-law pointer; serialized JSON/JSONL, snippets and absent cache artifacts are not legal-text evidence."],"shared_key":"{\"basis_code\":\"printed_eo_text\",\"source\":{\"page_or_item\":\"50 U.S.C. 1802 note; note 'Ex. verify its scope against the complete source pages.","signals":["shall","shall"],"text":"(a) When the President, or the Secretary of State or the Secretary \nof the Treasury pursuant to authority delegated by the President and in \naccordance with the terms of such delegation, has determined that sanctions \nshall be imposed on a person pursuant to sections 224(a)(2), 231(a), 232(a), \nor 233(a) of CAATSA and has selected from section 235 of CAATSA any \nof the sanctions set forth below to impose on that person, the Secretary \nof the Treasury, in consultation with the Secretary of State, shall take the \nfollowing actions where necessary to implement the sanctions selected and \nmaintained by the President, the Secretary of State, or the Secretary of \nthe Treasury: \n(i) prohibit any United States financial institution from making loans \nor providing credits to the sanctioned person totaling more than \n$10,000,000 in any 12-month period, unless the person is engaged in \nactivities to relieve human suffering and the loans or credits are provided \nfor such activities; \n(ii) prohibit any transactions in foreign exchange that are subject to the \njurisdiction of the United States and in which the sanctioned person \nhas any interest; \n(iii) prohibit any transfers of credit or payments between financial institu-\ntions, or by, through, or to any financial institution, to the extent that \nsuch transfers or payments are subject to the jurisdiction of the United \nStates and involve any interest of the sanctioned person; \n(iv) block all property and interests in property of the sanctioned person \nthat are in the United States, that hereafter come within the United States, \nor that are or hereafter come within the possession or control of any \nUnited States person, and provide that such property and interests in \nproperty may not be transferred, paid, exported, withdrawn, or otherwise \ndealt in; verify its scope against the complete source pages.","signals":["shall","shall","shall","shall","shall","shall","shall","shall","shall","shall","shall"],"text":"(a) When the President, or the Secretary of State or the Secretary \nof the Treasury pursuant to authority delegated by the President and in \naccordance with the terms of such delegation, has determined that sanctions \nshall be imposed on a person pursuant to sections 224(a)(2), 231(a), 232(a), \nor 233(a) of CAATSA and has selected from section 235 of CAATSA any \nof the sanctions set forth below to impose on that person, the heads of \nrelevant departments and agencies, in consultation with the Secretary of \nState and the Secretary of the Treasury, as appropriate, shall ensure that \nthe following actions are taken where necessary to implement the sanctions \nselected and maintained by the President, the Secretary of State, or the \nSecretary of the Treasury: \n(i) The Export-Import Bank shall deny approval of the issuance of any \nguarantee, insurance, extension of credit, or participation in an extension \nof credit in connection with the export of any goods or services to the \nsanctioned person; \n(ii) Departments and agencies shall not issue any specific license or grant \nany other specific permission or authority under any statute that requires \nthe prior review or approval of the United States Government as a condition \nfor the export or reexport of goods or technology to the sanctioned person; \n(iii) The United States executive director of each international financial \ninstitution shall use the voice and vote of the United States to oppose \nany loan from the international financial institution that would benefit \nthe sanctioned person; \n(iv) With respect to a sanctioned person that is a financial institution: \nthe Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and the Federal \nReserve Bank of New York shall not designate, or permit the continuation \nof any prior designation of, the sanctioned person as a primary dealer \nin United States Government debt instruments; and departments and agen-\ncies shall prevent the sanctioned person from serving as an agent of \nthe United States Government or serving as a repository for United States \nGovernment funds; \n(v) Departments and agencies shall not procure, or enter into a contract \nfor the procurement of, any goods or services from the sanctioned person; \n(vi) The Secretary of State shall deny a visa to, and the Secretary of \nHomeland Security shall exclude from the United States, any alien that \nthe President, the Secretary of State, or the Secretary of the Treasury \ndetermines is a corporate officer or principal of, or a shareholder with \na controlling interest in, the sanctioned person by treating the person \nas covered by section 1 of Proclamation 8693 of July 24, 2011 (Suspension \nof Entry of Aliens Subject to United Nations Security Council Travel \nBans and International Emergency Economic Powers Act Sanctions);
